text: The project replaces disconnected manual work with one controlled digital workspace.
Resident details scattered across registers and spreadsheets
Room and bed status changes are hard to track
Gate movement depends on manual verification
Different roles need different access to hostel data
SHMS brings these workflows together while protecting each hostel's records with verified tenant rules.
A practical system for owners, staff, residents, and parents.
Keep hostel, student, facility, staff, and allocation information together.
Apply authentication, roles, and verified hostel context on every protected operation.
Retain lifecycle history for allocations, gate records, and important status changes.
Use a modular MERN structure for the remaining hostel services.
The deployed structure keeps the user interface, API logic, and data storage separate.

The access model separates platform oversight from individual hostel responsibilities.

The interface supports real CRUD workflows with server-side tenant checks.
Implemented controls include search, status handling, account rules, photo support, and verified hostel ownership.

text: The planned gate design makes each QR token short-lived and single-use.
Verification checks: token validity, expiry, usage state, active student, same hostel, and correct gate.
After successful scanning, the token is marked used and the system records the guard, gate, date, time, QR reference, and movement type.
The supplied editable ER model covers the core information required across hostel operations.

Reference entities include Admin, Student, Parent, Staff, Outpass, Entry or Exit, Block, Floor, and Room. The current application also adds Hostel Membership, Bed, Allocation, and secure QR token records.
The supplied DFD shows how Admin, Student, Parent, and Staff exchange data with the central system.
In the implementation, every protected request also passes through authentication, role authorization, and verified hostel context before data is returned or changed.
The working foundation protects both data access and workflow integrity.
Scrypt password hashing and signed JWTs
Image signature, type, and size checks
94 backend tests passed in the latest verified run. The frontend production build also passed.
The project has a working operational core. Remaining modules extend that core without weakening security rules.
